lead_raw_text:
This structure of composition Mg4Ti8Zn4O24 (reduced formula MgTi2ZnO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ti and Zn each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, while Mg is coordinated by eight O neighbors and O centers have two geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner-sharing between Ti and Zn octahedra, with additional corner and edge sharing observed among Ti octahedra and between Mg and Ti polyhedra.
